name: NSW IPC MNDB Scheme Data Snapshot
reporting_scheme: Mandatory Notification of Data Breach Scheme
unit_of_observation: One explicitly identified cell in the sector snapshot table
source_threshold: Eligible data breach notifications made by NSW public sector agencies under Part 6A of the PPIP Act.
source_population: Notifications received from NSW government, local government, university and state-owned corporation sectors.
public_window: Historical six-month PDF snapshots indexed by the IPC.
source_licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, subject to the IPC copyright notice
correction_process: Check the latest IPC Reporting on the Scheme index and the identified source table.
limitations: The first adapter extracts only the page 5 sector table.
Values shown only in chart graphics are deliberately excluded.
Percentages may not total 100 percent and multi-cause categories can overlap.
